stem: At shift change, an irrigation issue has been contained but still needs follow-up. Which handoff is most useful?
choices: Something was wrong in Room 2; good luck
Room 2 Zone C had no flow at 14:20; valve was isolated per procedure, affected plants were identified, work order 184 is open, and supervisor was notified
The next shift can check everything again from the beginning
rationale: A useful handoff preserves specific location, time, action, affected scope, open work and notification status so the next shift can continue the controlled process without relying on memory.
